title: Matched Motion Ablation, Independent Pedagogical Review & Agent Authoring Readiness
primary_study: Within-case comparison of exact V3-57 motion candidate to matched static within-beat (end-state held) control; same fixed 5 beats, same QKV/Fraction/UNKNOWN facts, same host narration, same native timings, 15fps 1280x720 H264/AAC; independent paired reviews required.

intervention_definition.A: Original V3-57 authored-by-host animated beat states
intervention_definition.B: Keep end-state t=1.0 throughout each beat; no intra-beat animation, retain between-beat cuts
intervention_definition.fidelity_confound: Static-first treatment previews end state earlier; can test presence of intra-beat animation but cannot isolate all pedagogical factors
ablation_limits: Holding end-state from beat start may reveal result earlier and bias causal explanation; score as combined reveal/pacing intervention
Cannot infer general teaching benefit from visual metrics without human learning outcomes

preregistered_variables.independent: animation within each beat, otherwise preserved exact same plan/voice/time
dependent_proxies: decoded pixel evidence of temporal change

rater_protocol.random_assignment: Deterministic SHA256 of (parent SHA + case ID + condition) assign positions and publish after results
questions: Which treatment makes the causal state change more understandable and why?
Could the learner predict the next change?
Are claim and on-screen evidence consistent?
Do any transitions happen before the explanation is established?
Is text legible at normal 720p display?
Are statically held frames better than motion in any beat?
rater_protocol.score_anchors: Ordinal 1-5 subjective response for clarity, causal witness, continuity, legibility, pacing; 'unratable' allowed
rater_protocol.metric_guard: No computed pixel motion or arbitrary size threshold substitutes for external humans

quality_gates.technical: PASS only if source/paired movies physically ffprobe/decoded/matched AAC with CI artifact verified

safety: No model inference, no 3B1B copyrighted material in repo, no arbitrary LLM Python, no V2 Core / production dispatch changes.
